text:
sam: Nimbus Insurance requests a 3-week POC: streaming + function/tool calls for structured claims extraction, SOC2 evidence, and a headline reserved-price for trial. Need engineer runbook + price note.

jenna: Stack? Node frontend, Python workers, small Go adapter?

sam: Yes.

miguel: Node snippet for streaming + function_call + structured output:
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-large-v2',stream:true,structured_output:true,tools:[{name:'extract_claim'}]});
s.on('function_call', async (call)=>{const res=await adapter.post('/extract',{text:call.args.text});await s.resume({tool_result:res});});
```
Prefer SSE for one-way live updates; websockets for bi-directional low-latency.

devon: Ops POC defaults: batch_size=1, max_concurrency=4, prefix_kv_cache=true, fallback=smaller-model. For large docs enable KV caching; use 8-bit quantized variant if latency needs improvement.

priya: Security checklist to prep SOC2 responses: data residency, retention, KMS use, subprocessors, PII usage. If they will send PII recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or client-side redaction. Need customer security contact + sample payloads.

elaine: Pricing sketch: 3-week small reserved bucket (~$6k) + overage at list; possible 20% one-time POC discount pending deal-desk. Audit/log retention add-ons priced separately.

jenna: I'll assemble Postman + minimal Node/Python examples.

miguel: Note: enforce JSON schema on both model/tool sides; fallback to raw text UI on mismatch.

devon: Minimal runbook: set REDWOOD_API_KEY, start SSE stream to /v1/streams?model=..., on function_call -> POST adapter -> POST /streams/resume with tool_result, enable traces.

elaine: I'll draft pricing + SOW blurb and send to Sam EOD.

sam: Action items: Jenna Postman; Miguel code samples; Devon ops runbook; Priya questionnaire; Elaine pricing/SOW. Target customer email in 24h. :thumbsup:

redwood-bot: Tag thread #poc-handovers when ready for sales-ops tracking.

sam: Thanks everyone.
